title: The studies we depend on, reproduced
description: 6 papers the interface study depends on: each one's specimen and process history written in our language as the paper states them, simulated, and set beside the paper's numbers.

title: Reproducing Vitkavage, Irene and Massoud 1990: interface charges on four orientations of silicon
description: Vitkavage, Irene and Massoud 1990: the specimen and the timing of its process history as the paper states them, our encoding beside them item by item, the simulation in ISL, and how far it lands from the paper's numbers (9 within, 4 near, 8 off).
